newsitem.title: USA: Gap Inc June same-store sales rise 5 pct. [CORRECTED 17:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Gap Inc June same-store sales rise 5 pct. [CORRECTED 17:30 GMT]

text.p: Gap Inc Thursday reported June same-store sales rose five percent versus a 12 percent increase in the same month one year ago.
Total sales for the five weeks ended July 5, were $532 million, an increase of 21 percent over the $439 million for the comparable period last year.

For the 22 weeks ended July 5, same-store sales decreased (corrects from increased) one percent from the year ago level while total sales rose 14 percent to $2.18 billion from $1.91 billion last year.
